findings.reason: the followup must be re-pointed at §6 (its gating is now satisfied, `g-tprt-portfolio-mode` passed), or the plan's last section is unreachable by the route the plan itself declares.
findings.text: the open driving followup `f-tprt-003` carries `data-recommends-skill="/reckon-build the-portfolio-reads-true §5"` and body "Build §5, then §7, then §6", yet §5 is declared `done` (meta `plan-section-declarations` s5:done; comment `c-close-s5`, merge `08984a146`) and §7 is declared `done` (comment `c-close-s7`, merge `06d02d423`), leaving §6 the only open section — so the one route a coordinator dispatches from names a section that has already landed and never reaches §6, the same defect class the earlier review raised on `f-tprt-002`

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `the-codebase-is-reviewed-between-nodes#s8` resolves (`docs/plans/the-codebase-is-reviewed-between-nodes.html:215`, `data-id="s8"`, `done`), self-refs `#s2`/`#s3` resolve, the archive anchors `#s2`, `#s2-repairs`, `#s3-staleness-from-last-commit`, `#s4-sprint-membership`, `#s5-section-relations-wire`, `#s7-section-gate` all exist, and the gate-evidence `path#section: label` form is the house convention.

rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — gate evidence resolves to in-repo plan anchors and the archive (`docs/evidence/archive/the-portfolio-reads-true-landed.html`); §6's round record is `docs/state/reckon/review.html`; no scratchpad or node-local path is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — new audit codes (`AGING`, `SPRINT_MEMBERSHIP`, `impl-meta-stale`) and gate ids are emitted data labels; cited code symbols (`derived_plan_age`, `unwired_plan_finding`, `derive_impl_from_sections`, `split_unpassed_gates`) are mechanism-named with no ticket, version or stage tags.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §7's root cause matches its cited evidence (comment `c-gate-blocks-plan-1010`), the gate close is supported by the-codebase-is-reviewed-between-nodes §8 landing, and the callers each mechanism relies on are named (`serve.py`, `mcp_views.py`, the three `unwired_plan_finding` callers).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each section and each gate names one deliverable/measure; §6 is a single proving run.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the sole open followup `f-tprt-003` still recommends `/reckon-build the-portfolio-reads-true §5`, but §5 (and §7) are declared done, so the one dispatch route into the remaining section §6 names a completed section.
